scripts.//test: --test-concurrency=4 is load-bearing, not tuning. These are integration tests: most files start real tmux sessions and real daemons, and each tmux session holds a pty. Running all 18 files at node's default concurrency (one per core) exhausted the machine's ptys — tmux failed with 'fork failed: Device not configured' and 82 tests fell over at once, none of them for a reason to do with the code.
